_comment: Photon Table, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over PhotonTableViewModel (gui/model.py): 'file' is the left window (open, copy, the file summary), 'photons' the right one (navigation, page fields, channel and kind filters, the table of records). Help and Guide are drawn by gui/app.py, which also colours the Kind column from core/record_kinds.yaml.
title: Photon Table

sections.title: TTTR file
sections.name: file
sections.description: The TTTR file and what it holds.
Open a TTTR file, or copy the rows shown now.

buttons.label: Open TTTR...
buttons.description: Open a TTTR file (.ptu, .ht3, .phu, ...). Dropping one on the window does the same.

buttons.label: Copy visible
buttons.description: Copy the visible rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

sections.text: Open a TTTR file, or drop one on this window, to inspect its photons.
sections.description: Shown until a file is loaded.
The file whose photons are listed.

How many photons the file holds (and how many marker records besides them), how long the measurement lasted (the last macro-time times the header's resolution) and how many micro-time channels the header declares.

How many records of each kind the file holds: photons, and the scanner's pixel, line-start, line-stop and frame markers as the file header names them. Markers the header does not name count as 'other marker'.
The routing channels that occur in the file.
What was loaded, why a file could not be opened, or what was copied.

sections.title: Records
sections.name: photons
sections.description: The records of the file, photons and markers, one row each, a page at a time.
Move through the records of the filtered selection a page at a time.

buttons.label: First
buttons.description: Jump to the first record of the filtered selection.

buttons.label: Last
buttons.description: Jump to the last full page of the filtered selection.

sections.description: Which records of the filtered selection the table shows now.

sections.label: First record
sections.description: Index of the first record shown, counted within the filtered selection. A value past the end is moved back so that the page stays full.

sections.label: Rows
sections.description: Rows shown at once (1 to 20000). Large pages are fine; the table only draws what fits the window.

sections.label: Channel
sections.description: Show only the records of one routing channel. 'All channels' keeps the file's order. Choosing a channel goes back to its first record.

sections.label: Kind
sections.description: Show every record, only the photons, only the marker records, or one kind of marker (pixel, line start, line stop, frame, other) the file holds. Works together with the channel filter; choosing a kind goes back to its first record.

One row per record of the page, photons and markers. Record is the index among the filtered records, File idx the index in the file, Kind what the record is (marker kinds are coloured). Click a header to sort the page, click again to reverse; right click a header to choose columns.

columns.title: Record
columns.tooltip: The record's index among the filtered records: the row number a script would address.

columns.title: File idx
columns.tooltip: The record's index in the raw file.

columns.title: Kind
columns.tooltip: What the record is: a photon, or a pixel, line-start, line-stop, frame or other marker. Each marker kind has its own colour.

columns.title: Channel
columns.tooltip: The routing channel: the detector of a photon, the marker channel of a marker.

columns.title: Micro time
columns.tooltip: The micro time: TCSPC channel of a photon after the laser pulse (a marker's micro time carries no arrival time; Leica SP8 files keep the marker bits there).

columns.title: Macro time [ms]
columns.tooltip: The macro time in milliseconds (macro-time units times the header's resolution; raw units when the resolution is unknown).
